about_the_game:
Be the Hero in Smutstone!

Step into the seductive world of Smutstone, the thrilling card game where you’ll collect powerful cards, battle ruthless foes, and work through a fierce campaign to overthrow a wicked Sorceress and rescue enchanting characters from danger. Each victory brings tantalizing rewards, as players unlock seductive, comic-style scenes while progressing through the game.

Throughout your journey, you'll strengthen and upgrade your cards to increase their power, earning saucy bonuses along the way. Fans of risqué card games will find plenty to enjoy as they gather and upgrade cards to take on powerful opponents—because only the strongest cards can prevail. After collecting the required number of specific character cards, players can even enhance those characters for added strength and unlock steamy new artwork.

Battling opponents and facing off against other players in duels make for exhilarating gameplay, but the seductive cut-scenes and collection of captivating characters truly set Smutstone apart. The unique blend of strategic card battles and an endless selection of jaw-dropping characters will leave players wishing every card game could be this enticing. As long as players continue leveling up, there’s always another scene too spicy to mention here, waiting to be unlocked.
